reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

To the veterans of IN-09 and across our nation: thank you for your courage and patriotism. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/sUwIQgy6a4

Happy birthday, @USMC! Always faithful for 251 years.

Started my week speaking to Members-elect about the reality of a Member’s job. As we prepare for the 120th Congress, it is important to remember that this job is not about Washington, it’s about service to your constituents back home. https://t.co/rxmZDIzTkx

Congress returns to Washington Monday with less than 2 months left in the year.

We cannot waste a single day or leave anything on the table. This isn’t the time to slow down. We’re in the final stretch, we must run through the tape and get our priorities across the finish line before we hand over the gavel.

It was a pleasure to visit 5th graders at Silver Creek Elementary! We talked about Congress and the responsibilities that come with representing IN-09. These students are already well on their way to becoming informed, participating citizens. Keep asking great questions! https://t.co/IOnNqxadeB

Headed back to Washington next week for the people of IN-09. It’s truly the greatest honor to represent you. I am working to hold government accountable, lower the cost of healthcare, secure our elections, and fight for the issues that matter to Hoosiers.🇺🇲
IN-09, it's Election Day! The right to vote is one of our most fundamental as Americans. Find your polling place at https://t.co/d2I7oZM1iA.
The Rural Health Transformation Program passed by @HouseGOP is making a difference in Indiana! https://t.co/hAHxTjNmrF

Proud to help secure a $7.9 million grant for the City of Madison Port Authority to improve safety along the historic Madison Railroad. Thank you, @USDOT, for recognizing the importance of this investment in our community’s infrastructure and safety! https://t.co/0c3KNKgUyS

Reminder to change your clocks! 

Back in July, I was proud to support the Sunshine Protection Act to make Daylight Saving Time permanent and avoid today’s unnecessary clock change. 

Unfortunately, this commonsense legislation remains stalled in the Senate. It’s time to get this done and give Americans more daylight in the evening year-round.

Transparency is the first step to healthcare affordability. By requiring pharmacy benefit managers to disclose what they earn, the @USDOL is helping employers negotiate fair prices for patients. Thank you @POTUS for putting American patients first!

https://t.co/BvJH1mVTqi

Brown County Bikes exemplifies the spirit of American entrepreneurship and the grit and determination to chase a dream. I was grateful for the opportunity to tour their operation and hear directly from their team about how our work in Washington can help this business grow.  

I’m proud to fight for policies that give small businesses, like Brown County Bikes, the freedom and opportunity to invest, grow, and serve visitors and residents of the 9th District.
Happy National First Responders Day to the men and women who keep IN-09 safe! We are grateful for your courage, sacrifice, and service on behalf of your fellow citizens. https://t.co/UWU3eUl439

Since taking office in 2023, we have returned $10 million to IN-09 residents through casework. Delivering tangible results and putting service first is my top priority. 
https://t.co/zXaKVfFBir

I enjoyed visiting their facility to learn more about their work and discuss how my https://t.co/egDQybHEfN

Huge news! The FIELDS Program will reduce fertilizer costs and reshore a critical industry, with Indiana leading the way. Thank you to @VP and @SecRollins for putting farmers first. https://t.co/tYv6380tJ1

Apply online at https://t.co/RgCDmrfgZZ or call the FEMA Helpline at (800) 621-3362. As always, you can call my office at (812) https://t.co/Pi7YU4jSEb

Thank you to @1SI_Chamber for having me for a fireside chat with business leaders from across IN-09. It was a privilege to discuss our work in Washington and learn how we can continue to help southern Indiana in Congress. I especially enjoyed the opportunity to talk about our https://t.co/aGiYa16g0i

My team was honored to attend their ribbon cutting in February and I enjoyed stopping by to see the important defense work happening here. Southern Indiana is home to a strong https://t.co/7ActbDaxV0

Thrilled to see this commonsense ruling! 

This is a major step toward keeping kids safe online and a good sign we are on the right track with the 16 & Up Act and the Guardian Act.  It’s time to restore parental rights for social media access for kids. https://t.co/Ye0XAzGI3V

The deadline to apply for individual assistance from @fema for the August disaster declaration is October 25. Apply online at https://t.co/RgCDmrfgZZ or call the FEMA Helpline at 800-621-3362. For further information and resources, call my office at (812) 288-3999. https://t.co/rxJy9wTj9d

Easy yes from me!

Proud to sign @VP’s pledge to fight fraud. The @WHFraudTF and @HouseGOP have been laser-focused on ensuring American taxpayer dollars are not stolen by scammers.

I’ve been leading this effort on @HouseCommerce by introducing the Strategic Task Force on Scam Prevention Act, which passed Committee and will soon head to the House floor.

Protecting Americans and their hard-earned dollars from scams and fraud is a priority I’ll keep fighting for.

Cybersecurity threats are challenging hospitals more than ever. My Rural Hospital Cybersecurity Enhancement Act will give rural providers the training and resources they need to respond to cyberattacks and continue serving their communities. 

Whether it’s strengthening rural hospitals, expanding broadband access, or cutting burdensome regulations, I’m focused on using my work on @HouseCommerce to deliver real results for Southern Indiana.

Happy 251st Birthday, U.S. Navy!

On October 13, 1775, the Continental Congress authorized a few armed vessels to intercept British supply ships. That small step launched a force that now stands watch on every ocean.

My late grandfather kept Navy aircraft flying as a mechanic at NAS Corpus Christi during World War II. To every sailor past and present, and to the families who serve alongside them: thank you for answering the call to protect and defend. 

Anchors aweigh! ⚓

It was an honor to join veterans and their families in Dearborn County and to celebrate the 100 1/2 birthday with WW2 Veteran George Klopp Sr!  I told him I’ll be back to celebrate his 101st.  Proud to know this living legend and patriot! 

Our freedom is possible because of patriots, like George, who answered the call to serve our country. 

Thank you!

Happy National Farmer's Day to the producers who make Indiana a leader in agriculture! 🌾

Indiana farmers work every day to feed our families and fuel our economy.  I’m proud to bring their voices to Congress and to fight for policies that support them! https://t.co/Di6DW8OLIB

Today, we honor Christopher Columbus and the courage, determination, and spirit of exploration that have shaped our nation’s history. 🇺🇸

From the earliest explorers and the westward-bound pioneers to the astronauts and scientists who continue to push boundaries, America has always been driven by a sense of adventure and discovery.
Congratulations to Katie Bailey! She is an excellent choice for this role. Couldn’t be prouder of her. @SpeakerBoehner and @GovBraun alum! https://t.co/4vim1DfWT2
Congratulations @KatieZacharia! https://t.co/TtdKSpZBh1

I agree with Chair @RepWesterman. Americans need more power and lower energy bills. The Senate's bill sets clear permitting deadlines, curbs endless litigation, and speeds up transmission and new generation. It's time to build. #PermittingReform https://t.co/eDCk4w5Vlo

A little over a year ago, Dean reached out to my office for help. When he shared in passing that he had lost his military medals, we got to work!  

My staff submitted his paperwork to the National Personnel Record Center, and this month, we were honored to present Dean with his replacement medals.

Thank you, Dean, for your service and sacrifice to our nation!🇺🇸

Indiana is proving what works in literacy, and the results speak for themselves.

The Science of Reading is helping deliver better outcomes for students, and we should ensure federal dollars support proven methods that help our children learn to read. https://t.co/Rn4sY95xtn

I always appreciate the opportunity to sit down with members of the Dearborn County Chamber of Commerce to discuss the issues of the day. We recently met for a roundtable discussion on the Working Families Tax Cuts, passed by @HouseGOP last year.

As a mother and former small business owner, I understand the challenges facing families and businesses in Southern Indiana. Hearing directly from the leaders who are creating jobs, growing businesses, and improving our communities is one of the things I value most about representing the 9th District.

Thank you to the Dearborn County Chamber for sharing your experiences, ideas, and perspectives. I’m proud to bring your valuable insight back to Washington as we work together to find solutions and keep Southern Indiana strong.

Bloomington Regional Rehabilitation Hospital plays a vital role in our community as both an employer and healthcare provider, serving approximately 1,000 Indiana residents each year. I enjoyed the opportunity to see how their advanced treatment options, like the Rise and Walk technology, are improving patient outcomes. Thank you to the Bloomington Regional team for your life changing work!

Members of my staff recently hosted the final Academy Day of 2026 at Decatur Jr./Sr. High School for students interested in attending a U.S. Service Academy.

Don’t forget! Applications for a Service Academy nomination are due this Friday, October 9.

Submit your application at https://t.co/WNmNniJm5Y.

Recently, I spoke to the Manufactured Housing Institute about my Affordable HOMES Act, which cuts an energy efficiency regulation that was driving up the cost of housing. I was pleased to work with the MHI on the legislation and to update them on our progress.  We must remove unnecessary regulations on manufactured housing to bring down the cost of owning a home in America.

October is #BreastCancerAwarenessMonth. 🩷

Breast Cancer can affect women even without a family history. Regular mammograms can help detect breast cancer early, when it is most treatable.

Make your health a priority and talk to your doctor today about when you should start screening.

Thanks for your leadership @RepWesterman! I couldn’t agree more. Happy to see this action in the Senate and ready to help in the House. America needs permitting reform. Cutting red tape will fast-track projects, create jobs, unlock our critical minerals and keep America competitive.

Once again, the Senate has failed to deliver for the American people.

Senate Democrats blocked @HouseGOP's commonsense legislation to ban Congressional stock trading.

The Senate votes on the Stop Insider Trading Act today.

Members of Congress should serve the American people, not their stock portfolios. https://t.co/DFabHxNXZ2

Today, the Senate will decide whether to listen to the American people and pass the SAVE America Act, or keep allowing illegal aliens to decide our elections.

It’s time to get it to the President’s desk. https://t.co/jy49j8ZbtP

roll_calls.question: On Passage — Sunshine Protection Act (H R 139)
roll_calls.plain_language: This bill makes daylight saving time the new, permanent standard time. A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.

post.text:
Reminder to change your clocks! 

Back in July, I was proud to support the Sunshine Protection Act to make Daylight Saving Time permanent and avoid today’s unnecessary clock change. 

Unfortunately, this commonsense legislation remains stalled in the Senate. It’s time to get this done and give Americans more daylight in the evening year-round.

Cybersecurity threats are challenging hospitals more than ever. My Rural Hospital Cybersecurity Enhancement Act will give rural providers the training and resources they need to respond to cyberattacks and continue serving their communities. 

Whether it’s strengthening rural hospitals, expanding broadband access, or cutting burdensome regulations, I’m focused on using my work on @HouseCommerce to deliver real results for Southern Indiana.

roll_calls.question: On Motion to Recommit — Stop Insider Trading Act (H R 7008)
roll_calls.plain_language: The Stop Insider Trading Act would bar members of Congress and their spouses and dependent children from buying stocks and would require public notice before a sale. This vote would have replaced that bill with a broader ban that also forces members, the President, the Vice President, and their spouses and dependent children to sell covered investments they already hold. A Yea would have made that swap; a Nay kept the original bill.

roll_calls.question: On Passage — Stop Insider Trading Act (H R 7008)
roll_calls.plain_language: This bill generally bars members of Congress and their spouses and dependent children from buying stocks, and it requires public notice before they sell. A Yea passes it in the House. A Nay votes against passage.
